# Search Specification

## Purpose

Describe stored-document search.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Existing Search

The system SHALL return matching documents.

#### Matching response

A matching document is returned.

### Requirement: Search Examples

The system SHALL display an inert Markdown example.

#### Example response

The example is displayed without changing the parsed delta.

```markdown
## REMOVED Requirements

### Requirement: Existing Search
```
